subtitle: Out Manila · Cebu Pacific
overview: Fly Cebu Pacific to Hanoi for a city tour, then travel up to Sapa for the Fansipan railway and cable car. Return to Hanoi, cruise Ha Long Bay with lunch and onboard activities, and spend a final night in Hanoi before flying home. All hotels are 4★, with a private coach and an English-speaking guide. This rate includes shopping stops.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Mar 30–Apr 3 2027 to May 11–15 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum: The mausoleum of Vietnam's founding leader at Ba Dinh Square; the tour makes a photo stop outside.
placeDesc.Presidential Palace: A yellow colonial-era palace in Hanoi, seen from outside with a photo stop.
placeDesc.36 Streets: Hanoi's Old Quarter, a maze of lanes traditionally named after the trades once sold there.
placeDesc.Hoan Kiem Lake: The central lake of Hanoi, with a small temple on an islet.
placeDesc.Sa Pa Church: A stone church from the French era in the middle of Sapa town.
placeDesc.Love Square: The main town square of Sapa, beside the church and tourist street.
placeDesc.Moana Sapa: A themed leisure and photo spot in Sapa visited before the hotel check-in.
placeDesc.Fansipan: The highest peak in Indochina, reached on this tour by cable car.
placeDesc.Muong Hoa Mountain Railway: A mountain railway linking Sapa town to the Fansipan cable car station.
placeDesc.Sung Sot Cave: One of the best-known caves in Ha Long Bay, with large chambers of limestone formations.
placeDesc.Titop Island: A small island in Ha Long Bay with a beach and a viewpoint over the bay.
placeDesc.Ga Choi Island: A rock formation in Ha Long Bay shaped like two fighting cocks.
placeDesc.Grand World Hanoi: A large themed entertainment and shopping complex near Hanoi; gondola ride not included.
